name: Ticket to the ITOPOD
description: (Tag:ticket)Sends you to the ITOPOD, the Infinite Tower of Pissed Off Dudes. Fight random enemies floor-by-floor in gauntlet format, each as strong as its floor; earn an item equal to your final floor, but death is permanent. One time use. (A/N: Each floor corresponds to a familiar whose rarity equals Floor Number divided by 10. Floor 1 is a 0.1 rarity familiar while floor 32 is a 3.2 familiar.)
